structured_output.what_is_happening: "The Colony" is an ant-themed Solana project in which autonomous AI-agent ants each hold a wallet (thecolony.lol, X account thecolonylol). It is being copied over and over today. This token (DZTz…ZabS) is NOT a pump.fun mint: the address has no "pump" suffix, migrated_unix is 0, and the pair was created about 5 seconds after the mint. The creator set up the PumpSwap pool directly and holds 100% of the LP, unlocked. RugCheck marks this "danger". The creator's token status is "creator_close" and the creator's balance is 0. The packet lists at least 7 other "The Colony"/COLONY tokens created within the last ~5 hours. Two of them had real volume and now show ~$0 liquidity: 7Wo9… (mcap $937k, liquidity $0.01, $28.7k h1 volume) and JCkF… ($195k h1 volume, $0 liquidity). That pattern points to repeated LP pulls on the same meme. The pump.fun-native Gh6k…pump is still alive with $15k liquidity and $107k h1 volume. This token's own flow: 1,111 unique buyers against only 105 sellers in 13 minutes, top-10 holders ~4%, 30 bundler wallets, 0 smart or KOL wallets.

narrative.description: AI-agent ant colony, 'one queen, thousands of ants', where autonomous agents forage and trade on Solana. It rides the AI-agent meme with a live 3D simulation site.
narrative.why_spreading: The original project has a working site showing a treasury (80 SOL) and a game mechanic. The AI-agent angle is current, and the copycat wave shows traders are chasing the name.

token_connection.why_this_token: It uses the same name and description and links to the same thecolony.lol site and thecolonylol X post. But its non-pump.fun mint and its dev-seeded, unlocked LP set it apart. Nothing on the site or in search ties this contract address to the project.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 7 same-name tokens. Gh6k…pump (pump.fun-native, $15k liquidity, $107k h1 volume) is still active. 7Wo9… and JCkF… show high recent volume and ~0 liquidity, which looks like they were rugged.

authenticity.evidence: This looks like a copy-paste launch from an LP-pull farm. It uses the same metadata and image (image_duplicate_count 6), the dev created the pool with 100% unlocked LP, and at least two sibling tokens under the same name already dropped to zero liquidity today. 30 bundler wallets. The buyer/seller ratio of 1,111 to 105 in 13 minutes is extreme and fits bot-driven or trapped buying.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts or on-chain LP ownership directly. The siblings' zero-liquidity status comes from the packet, and I could not confirm they share a creator.

structural_risks: 100% of LP is unlocked and was seeded by the creator, who can pull the ~$26k SOL side at any time
Non-pump.fun mint with a custom PumpSwap pool: the standard pump.fun LP burn does not apply
Same-name siblings with high volume already sit at ~0 liquidity
